title: Norm bound for cosine scaling
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every $u\in\mathbb R$, the linear map on $\mathbb R^n$ given by $x\mapsto(\cos u)x$ has operator norm at most $1$.
replaced: For every $n\ge0$ and $u\in\mathbb R$, the linear map $x\mapsto\cos u\,x$ on $\mathbb R^n$ has operator norm at most one for the maximum norm.
